sloka: आदिप्रभृति गेयं स्यान्न चावज्ञाय पार्थिवम् ।पिता हि सर्वभूतानां राजा भविति धर्मतः ।। ७.९३.१५ ॥
transliteration: ādiprabhṛti geyaṁ syānna cāvajñāya pārthivam ।pitā hi sarvabhūtānāṁ rājā bhaviti dharmataḥ ।। 7.93.15 ॥

translations.english: The Ramayana should be sung from the beginning, and the king should not be disrespected, for a king is indeed the father of all beings by virtue of dharma.
